exposure: Estimated fetal weight under the 3rd centile
Integrated models of biometric and hemodynamic ultrasound parameters
outcome: Placental underperfusion due to vascular obstruction (histological findings)
cohort: The review discusses studies on late-onset growth restriction fetuses and appropriate-for-gestational-age fetuses.
finding: Abnormal uterine artery Doppler may be a useful prognostic parameter in late-onset growth restriction fetuses and for identifying subclinical placental insufficiency in appropriate-for-gestational-age fetuses, particularly when integrated into multi-parameter models, though its standalone predictive capacity is limited and further evidence is needed.
birth_weight: Studies discussed pertain to fetuses with estimated fetal weight under the 3rd centile (for growth restriction) and those considered adequate for gestational age.
gest_age: The review focuses on fetuses in the third trimester for uterine artery Doppler evaluation and those with late-onset growth restriction.
